Current resume state

Updated 2026-09-08. Active task: CSP3. CSP3.1 is complete after merge 46767fb7 and fresh acceptance checks.

The canonical worktree remains /Users/jack/src/github.com/agentstation/starmap-catalog-requirements, branch codex/catalog-qualification. This update changes no production source. The merge evidence records task completion.

PR #135 merged at 6f299cce after fifteen successful checks. Its tree matches the reviewed proof-only candidate. Its worktree is /tmp/starmap-pr135-main-2026-09-08.

PR #136 candidate d5984e9a passes all 39 local stages, including 79 ordinary and 79 race packages. Required incremental review reports zero findings across three portions. Its worktree is /tmp/starmap-pr136-main-2026-09-08. Candidate b1857550 adds only the reviewed gRPC module patch. Its 67 credential tests and six consumer checks pass.

PR #136 published reviewed head 8e559680. The correction preserves qualification history and requires merged-source acceptance. Both reviewers report zero findings. Auto-merge awaits current CI and an up-to-date base.

The downstream record retains both reviews and full verification output. CSP2 awaits the remaining implementation merge and merged-source acceptance.

The token-price worktree is /tmp/starmap-token-cost-worktree-2026-09-08, branch codex/catalog-token-cost-presence. Commit 6f1117e7 preserves null and missing prices. Repair b4e436b1 passes 77 focused race results and all six consumer checks. It updates the fixed artifact digest after baseline regeneration.

Disk exhaustion interrupted its race build. The retained failure exits 143 after termination. The completed recording caches supplied about 2 GiB for recovery.

Verifier session 74957 exited 2 after ordinary and race suites passed. Gosec flagged a token-unit constant as a potential credential. Its output is /tmp/starmap-token-cost-presence-2026-09-08/unit-repair-publication-verify-serial.txt. Complete verification and review before publication.

PR #137 updates gRPC from 1.83.1 to 1.83.2 for advisory GHSA-2v4p-qf9q-27wj. Head 907b055c passed fifteen CI checks. GitHub refused its merge because main contained a newer commit.

Reviewed head c827c64d now includes merged #135 and awaits fresh CI. Credential tests pass 67 results on each toolchain. All six consumers pass. Fresh CI remains required.

The record-presence worktree is /tmp/starmap-record-presence-worktree-2026-09-08, branch codex/catalog-record-presence. Commit 77713578 preserves fourteen optional records and their original unknown receipts. The candidate evidence records 1,349 race results and 216 minimum-Go results. Committed receipt repair 02551bf8 passes 1,396 package race results and 286 minimum-Go results. Its repair evidence retains failures and the accepted-presence correction.

Definition candidate 42783dc6 passes 1,448 package race results and 53 minimum-Go results. Full verifier session 71547 runs in its worktree. Eight provider-offering null scenarios still fail, and capability OpenAPI schemas still reject null. Both repairs remain required before publication.

Merge follow-up cell 4526 waits for #136 workflow 34291140200. It verifies the merge, checks the dependency patch, closes redundant #137, and runs fresh CSP2 acceptance. Read its result before another merge attempt.

CSP2 candidate acceptance reports fourteen passing subcases, two failures from disk exhaustion, and six unmatched native captures. The five affected local commands now pass after cleanup. Fresh CI artifacts must replace the older native evidence before merged-source closeout.
